title: AB78 (2021 Regular): Revises provisions relating to background checks for certain sales or transfers of firearms. (BDR 15-16)

operative_text: Section 1 (NRS 202.2548): The sale or transfer of a firearm to a person who possesses a permit to carry a concealed firearm issued pursuant to the provisions of NRS 202.3653 to 202.369, inclusive.
